T:P1.2.text: Concrete Pumping Holdings is the leading provider of concrete pumping services and concrete waste management solutions in the U.S. and U.K., operating under the only established, national brands in both countries.

T:P1.3.text: Concrete Pumping Holdings is the leading provider of concrete pumping services in the highly fragmented U.S. and U.K. markets, operating under the only established, national brands in both markets (Brundage-Bone and Camfaud, respectively). Concrete pumping is a "mission-critical" method of concrete placement that requires highly-skilled operators to position a truck-mounted fully-articulating boom for precise delivery of ready-mix concrete from mixer trucks to placing crews on a job site. CPH's large fleet of specialized pumping equipment and highly-trained operators position CPH ...

T:P1.4.text: CPH is also the leading provider of concrete waste management services in the U.S. market, operating under the only established, national brand, Eco-Pan. Highly complementary to its core concrete pumping service, Eco-Pan provides a full-service, cost-effective, regulatory-compliant solution to manage environmental issues caused by concrete washout.

T:P1.5.text: As of, the Company provided concrete pumping services in the U.S. from a footprint of multiple branch locations across approximately 20 states, concrete pumping services in the U.K. from multiple branch locations, and route-based concrete waste management services from multiple operating locations in the U.S. and 1 shared location in the U.K.

T:P1.6.text: For more information, please visit www.concretepumpingholdings.com or the Company’s brand websites at www.brundagebone.com, www.camfaud.co.uk, or www.eco-pan.com.

T:P1.8.text: Brundage-Bone is the largest concrete pumping and material placement service provider in the United States.

T:P1.10.text: Capital Pumping is a leading provider of concrete pumping services in Texas.

T:P1.12.text: Camfaud is the largest concrete pumping and material placement service provider in the United Kingdom.

T:P1.14.text: Eco-Pan is the leading provider of environmental waste management services to the concrete industry in the United States. We specialize in concrete cleanup and disposal services across the country.

T:P1.15.text: Our team has extensive expertise in providing top-notch concrete pumping service in the U.S. under the Brundage-Bone brand, concrete pumping service in the U.K. under the Camfaud brand, and concrete waste management services in the U.S. under the Eco-Pan brand.

C:P1.1.text: Home | APi Group | Building Great Leaders

C:P1.2.text: APi Group is a market-leading business services provider of safety and specialty services.

C:P1.3.text: The future of business services is in good hands

C:P1.4.text: Choose APi Group for market-leading business solutions, safety and specialty services.

C:P1.5.text: We provide quality, reliable business services that give potential everything it needs to thrive.

C:P1.6.text: Satisfy all the OSHA requirements with our world-class solutions, systems, and programs for risk response.

C:P1.7.text: Every job is different, and our award-winning lineup of capabilities can help you achieve incomparable results.

C:P1.8.text: A shared legacy of leadership is all in the family of APi Group companies.

C:P1.10.text: Our enduring purpose is Building Great Leaders®.

C:P1.11.text: Our commitment to you goes beyond the workplace. You will have access to benefits, resources, and a global community that supports all aspects of your well-being.​

C:S1.1.text: In our Safety Services segment, we protect clients' personnel and assets with expertly designed fire detection and suppression systems, electronic security and monitoring solutions, elevators, and escalators. In our Specialty Services segment, we offer premier solutions in infrastructure, energy, telecommunications, specialty contracting, complete HVAC, fabrication, and material distribution.

C:S2.1.text: APi Group describes itself as a business services provider of fire and life safety, security, elevator and escalator, and specialty services, with multiple locations worldwide. Its current structure has two reportable segments, Safety Services and Specialty Services.

C:S3.1.text: The work performed within this segment spans across industries and facilities and includes commercial, education, healthcare, high tech, industrial, and special-hazard settings.

C:S4.1.text: In January 2025, APi moved its HVAC business from Safety Services to Specialty Services, due to a change in the way the businesses are managed. Historical segment information was recast to match.

C:S5.1.text: Specialty Services customers include utilities, communications, healthcare, education, transportation, manufacturing, industrial plants, and government agencies in North America.
